name: Pottstown
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pottstown, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Pottstown, Pennsylvania for 2026: Santa Saturday, free Santa photos, a gingerbread workshop and the downtown tree lighting.
lede: Pottstown packs its holiday kickoff into Santa Saturday, with a gingerbread workshop, free Santa photos and a tree lighting with the school carolers, all downtown.
celebrates: Discover Pottstown organizes Santa Saturday on December 5, with 19 events listed on its downtown calendar, according to its holiday page. Families start with a gingerbread workshop at the Pottstown Children's Discovery Center, stop for free photos with Santa at the Clock Tower Parking Lot, and finish at Smith Family Plaza, where the Pottstown School Carolers sing before the tree is lit at 6 pm. The Pottstown Regional Public Library also holds a story time at noon. Montgomery Community College brings the tree and new ornaments each year.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Pottstown's tree lighting. A Patch roundup of December events in Pottstown describes the annual tree lighting as the moment the community's Christmas tree comes to life with sparkling lights, and a Discover Pottstown post invites families to sing along with the Pottstown School Carolers as they light the tree at Smith Family Plaza.
facts: This year's tree is a blue spruce from Whispering Treetops Tree Farm, Discover Pottstown says, and the lighting takes place at Smith Family Plaza, 100 East High Street, beside Borough Hall. The plaza hosts a choral ensemble out front of Borough Hall, according to a local event post. The Pottstown Children's Discovery Center is at 95 Hanover Street, and its gingerbread houses come prebuilt for young decorators.
trains: Pottstown does not have its own Christmas train, but the Colebrookdale Railroad runs holiday trains from Boyertown in neighboring Berks County. The dates reported by different sources did not match when we checked, so confirm them on the railroad's own site before planning a trip. The closest verified Bucks County option is New Hope Railroad's Santa trains, listed on our New Hope page.
traditions: A day of 19 listed downtown events on December 5, organized by Discover Pottstown.

kidfact: The tree in Pottstown's plaza is a blue spruce from a tree farm, and new ornaments are added every year.
faq: What is Santa Saturday in Pottstown?
Discover Pottstown lists Santa Saturday on December 5, 2026, with 19 events including a gingerbread workshop, free Santa photos, a library story time and the tree lighting.
Where is the Pottstown tree lighting?
Smith Family Plaza, 100 East High Street, at 6 pm on December 5, according to Discover Pottstown.
Are Santa photos free in Pottstown?
Yes. Discover Pottstown lists free photos with Santa at the Clock Tower Parking Lot from noon to 3 pm, with free digital files.
Is there a train ride near Pottstown?
The Colebrookdale Railroad runs holiday trains from Boyertown, but the dates we found conflicted, so check the railroad's site.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Pottstown for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Christmas at Historic Trappe) through January 10, 2027, with the Trappe Tree Lighting (December 2), Santa Saturday in Downtown Pottstown (December 5) and the Collegeville Tree Lighting with Santa (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
